resultado.summary:
Short version: WhatsApp's rules and group mechanics argue against building DV Digital's organic channel on ~50 big groups filled by mass-adding the 50,000+ numbers. Groups do have enough room: each holds up to 1,024 members, so 50 groups × 1,024 ≈ 51k. But regular groups cannot hide members' phone numbers, even when only admins can post. That would show every customer's number to up to ~1,000 strangers and to competitors.

Communities are the one group-style format that hides numbers. In the announcement group, numbers are visible only to admins and to people who already have them. But a community holds at most 2,000 members in total (it was cut from 5,000 in 2023) and at most 100 groups. The Help Center also says a community can't currently be created in the WhatsApp Business app. Secondary sources contradict that, so it needs a test on a phone.

WhatsApp's own Help Center tells businesses not to add people to groups without permission, and not to use numbers from illicit sources to message people or add them to groups. It also says not to create groups in automated ways. It detects abuse with machine learning plus user reports. A restricted account cannot start new chats, create groups or add members. Since August 2025, anyone added by a non-contact first sees a "safety overview" and can leave at once, and the group's notifications stay muted until they choose to stay. So mass-adding brings exits, reports and bans.

The "who can add me to groups" setting (Everyone / My contacts / My contacts except…) turns a blocked direct add into a private invite. The person has 3 days to accept, and the setting never blocks invite links. Invite links can be revoked and reset (an old link can't be restored), and admins can turn on "approve new members" (off by default).

Broadcast lists in the Business app are capped at 256 contacts, and only people who saved the business number receive them. The newer paid "business broadcasts" require opt-in and are billed per message by the recipient's country code. Reports say they come with 250 free messages per 30 days during a trial, and the Help Center says spam reports can suspend them for 3 days. WhatsApp has also been testing a monthly cap on messages to people who never reply, announced October 2025. The cap's value is unconfirmed; one low-quality report cites 1,000.

WhatsApp Channels fit a 50k promo feed best. There is no documented follower cap, and followers can't see each other. Viewers can't see followers' numbers, and whether admins can see the follower list is unclear. Channels allow up to 16 extra admins, and since June 2025 they can be promoted. Followers cannot reply or DM, though; they can only react and vote in polls. So every post needs a wa.me click-to-chat link with a pre-filled product code that opens a private chat with the business number, where the AI agent answers. Automated posting to Channels or to app groups is only possible through unofficial tools (Whapi, WAHA), which break the Terms of Service.

Meta's official Groups API cannot run the promo groups. It needs an Official Business Account, joining is by invite link only, and it isn't available for Business-app or coexistence numbers. Secondary sources give 8 participants per group. What does fit is "coexistence": one number used at the same time in the Business app (for manual groups, Channel and Status) and in the Cloud API (for the agent), at 20 messages per second. Group messages are not synced to the API.

Usernames launched on 29 June 2026, rolling out country by country. People who set one show the username instead of their number to non-contacts, including in groups. Businesses on the API now also get a business-scoped user ID (BSUID) in webhooks, so the database should not treat the phone number as the only key.

Evidence caveat: WebFetch was blocked for every domain, so all evidence comes from WebSearch extracts of the named pages, mostly faq.whatsapp.com, about.fb.com and developers.facebook.com. Confidence is therefore capped at medium.

claims.claim: A regular WhatsApp group can have at most 1,024 members; when full, invite links fail with 'group size limit has been reached'. 50 groups x 1,024 is about 51,200 seats, so ~50 groups is the right order of magnitude only if every seat fills.

sources.title: Can't join group | WhatsApp Help Center
sources.quote: The group size limit has been reached. A WhatsApp group can have up to 1,024 members.

sources.title: How to add and remove group members | WhatsApp Help Center
WhatsApp unveils Communities feature, raises group limit to 1,024 participants (GSMArena, Nov 2022)

claims.claim: Communities: up to 100 groups per community, and a hard cap of 2,000 members per community that counts sub-groups and the announcement group together (reduced from 5,000 around March 2023). Reaching 50,000 people would take 25+ communities, so communities do not solve scale.

sources.quote: You can have up to 2,000 members in new and existing communities. This limit includes the total number of members in the sub-groups and announcement groups within the community.

sources.title: Matt Navarra on X (Mar 2023)
sources.quote: WhatsApp has reduced the maximum size of Community broadcast channels to 2,000 members Previously limit was 5,000 members

claims.claim: In a community's Announcements group, members' phone numbers are hidden from each other: a number is visible only to community admins, people who saved it, or people who have it from other chats. Only admins can see the member count. Members can react to and reply to announcements, replies can't be turned off, and other members can read the replies. An admin who @mentions a member exposes that member's number to the whole community.

sources.quote: To protect user privacy, your phone number is only visible to community admins, people who have saved your number in their contacts, or those who have your number from your other chats.

sources.quote: Don't @mention any member in the Announcement group, as doing so will expose that contact's phone number to the entire community.

claims.claim: Regular groups, including 'only admins can send messages' groups, do NOT hide the participant list or phone numbers. The admin-only setting controls only who can post. Every member of a 1,024-person promo group can see the other members' numbers, unless a member has set a username (see g5).

They can exit without opening the chat, and group notifications stay silenced until they choose to stay. So mass-added promo groups start out muted, and many people will leave or report them.

claims.claim: Official ban and restriction triggers: adding people to groups without permission; using numbers from illicit sources, or sharing them without consent, to message people or add them to groups; creating accounts or groups in unauthorized or automated ways; bulk messaging or auto-messaging; being reported or blocked repeatedly. WhatsApp uses machine learning plus user reports, and also judges groups by basic information such as subject and photo. A restricted account can't start chats with new contacts, create groups, add members or use linked devices. Groups themselves can also be suspended.

sources.title: How to use WhatsApp responsibly | WhatsApp Help Center
sources.quote: Get permission from contacts before you add them to a group. If you add someone to a group and they remove themselves, honor their decision... Don't share phone numbers without consent or use data obtained from illicit sources to message users on WhatsApp or add them to groups.

sources.quote: Don't bulk message, auto-message, or auto-dial using WhatsApp... don't create accounts or groups in unauthorized or automated ways, or use modified versions of WhatsApp.

sources.quote: When your account is restricted, you can't start chats or calls with new contacts, create new groups, add new members to groups, or use linked devices.

claims.claim: WhatsApp's Terms of Service ban bulk messaging, auto-messaging and non-personal use unless authorized. Since 2019 WhatsApp has warned it will take legal action against companies engaged in or assisting automated/bulk messaging, even based only on off-platform evidence. Unofficial or modified clients violate the Terms. Tools that automate app groups or Channels (web-session APIs such as Whapi.Cloud and WAHA) are therefore unauthorized and put the number at ban risk.

People viewing a channel can't see who follows it or followers' numbers; whether admins can see the follower list is unclear. Up to 16 additional admins are allowed. No official follower cap was found, and secondary sources say there is none. Since 16 June 2025 channels can be promoted in the directory and offer paid subscriptions.

Secondary sources report a limit of 8 participants per group, with up to 10,000 groups per number.

Throughput is fixed at 20 messages per second. Group-chat messages are not synced to the API, which only syncs 1:1 history, up to 180 days back. App groups stay manual and invisible to the backend.

claims.claim: Getting shoppers from a group or channel into a private chat: a wa.me click-to-chat link can pre-fill text, e.g. https://wa.me/57XXXXXXXXXX?text=<url-encoded>, so each offer can carry a product code the agent can parse. In groups, members can also use 'Reply privately'. Because the shopper sends the first message, the business can reply without a paid first-contact template. Forwarding one post to many chats is limited: 5 chats at once, and a message 'forwarded many times' only 1 chat at a time.

sources.quote: use https://wa.me/whatsappphonenumber?text=urlencodedtext where whatsappphonenumber is a full phone number in international format and urlencodedtext is the URL-encoded pre-filled message.

claims.claim: Business Messaging Policy: a business may contact someone only if the person gave their number (or username) AND opted in to receive messages from that named business. Cloud API webhooks have included a business-scoped user ID (BSUID) since April 2026, and sending to a BSUID was due in July 2026. People with usernames may not expose their phone number to the business at all.

sources.title: WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy
sources.quote: You may only contact people on WhatsApp if: (a) they have given you their mobile phone number...; and (b) you have received opt-in permission from the recipient confirming that they wish to receive subsequent messages or calls from you.

sources.title: Business-scoped user IDs - Meta for Developers
sources.quote: BSUID will be assigned to the user_id parameter and appear in all messages webhooks, regardless of whether or not the user has enabled the username feature.

design_implications: Do NOT mass-add the 50k numbers to groups, whether by hand or with tools. It breaks the Help Center rule on adding without permission (g10). Since August 2025, non-contacts who add someone trigger a safety overview and muted notifications (g9). People who set 'My contacts' only get a 3-day invite anyway (g8). Grow membership only through people choosing to join via invite links (or a channel follow link), sent through channels where consent can be shown.

Main promo feed: one WhatsApp Channel run from the business number. It has no documented follower cap, followers' numbers stay hidden from other viewers, and there is no participant list to scrape (g15). Groups can be secondary, optional segments. Each Channel post carries a wa.me deep link with a product/offer code (g19), e.g. 'Hola, quiero la oferta OF-123 (canal)'. The Cloud API agent parses that code, looks up price and stock, confirms name and Colombian address, asks for an explicit 'sí', and creates the Shopify COD order.

If groups are used: turn on 'only admins can send' and 'approve new members', reset links that leak, and keep one link per group so joins can be traced. Tell members plainly that other members can see their number (g4). Because of that exposure, prefer community announcement groups (g3). They are capped at 2,000 members per community (g2) and possibly can't be created from the Business app (g6), so test that before designing around them.

Architecture: one number in coexistence mode (g18). The Business app handles Channel, group and Status posting by hand. The Cloud API webhook feeds the Next.js + Claude agent that handles 1:1 orders. Build no backend integration that reads or posts in app groups or Channels: there is no official API for them (g16, g17), and unofficial tools (Whapi, WAHA, Baileys) risk a ban on the number that takes the orders (g11).
The Cloud API Groups API (OBA only; secondary sources say about 8 participants) does not fit promo groups (g17). At most it could serve small VIP or support groups later.

Dashboard: the backend can't see app-group membership or Channel follower lists. Measure each group or channel by per-source codes in the wa.me pre-filled text and by per-group invite links. Store a campaign/offer table that generates those links and ready-to-paste post text, so an admin can post to 50 groups quickly. Forwarding reaches only 5 chats at a time (g19), so plan roughly 10 manual batches per offer, or post once to the Channel and forward from it.

Data model: key customers on BSUID plus optional phone plus optional username (g20). Store an opt-in record per contact (source, timestamp, wording) before any business-initiated message. Outbound reactivation of the 50k should use Cloud API marketing templates only for contacts with documented opt-in. The Business app's free broadcast lists (256 contacts, number must be saved) and paid business broadcasts (g13, g14) do not scale to 50k.

Throttle any outbound first-contact volume and watch block and report signals. The unreplied-message cap being tested (g12) and report-driven restrictions (g10) mean spikes to people who never reply can freeze the account. Prefer flows where the customer messages first (wa.me links), which also avoid paid first-contact template fees.
open_questions: Can a community actually be created from the WhatsApp Business app in Colombia today (the Help Center says no; 2026 guides say yes)? Test on a device before relying on communities.

Current Groups API participant cap: secondary sources say 8, but the official developer page didn't show it in search. Check developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/groups directly.
Has the monthly cap on messages to non-responders (tested since October 2025) launched globally? What is the value, and does it apply to Business-app sends, Cloud API template sends, or both?
Are usernames live for Colombian users as of 2026-09-25, and how widely have they been adopted? That decides how much number exposure in groups is really reduced.
Can Channel admins see a follower list or names? The Help Center only says viewers can't. Also, does Meta offer any official Channels API in 2026?

Do the 50,000+ numbers have documented opt-in naming DV Digital as the sender, meeting Meta's Business Messaging Policy and Colombia's Ley 1581 (habeas data)? This is covered by the legal topic, but it decides whether any business-initiated message or invite is allowed.
The exact limits and current pricing of paid 'business broadcasts' in the Business app (recipients per send, free quota) for Colombia; the Help Center pages were not readable directly.
resultado.tool_problems: WebFetch was blocked by the network egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for every domain tried: faq.whatsapp.com, www.whatsapp.com, business.whatsapp.com, blog.whatsapp.com, developers.facebook.com, and third-party sites (inviter.co, respond.io, support.whapi.cloud, en.wikipedia.org, wha.tools, bleepingcomputer.com, wabetainfo.com, useinvent.com). A request to read the proxy status or README was refused by the permission classifier and was not retried. All evidence therefore comes from WebSearch result extracts and summaries of the listed URLs. The quotes are the search engine's extract of those official pages, not text read verbatim from an opened page, so confidence is capped at medium even for official Help Center statements. Anything contested or from secondary sources is marked low (community creation in the Business app, the unreplied-message cap value, Channels API availability, the Groups API 8-participant cap).

resultado.summary:
Main finding: the official WhatsApp Cloud API can't run large promo groups. The Groups API is real, but only an Official Business Account (OBA) can use it. People join only through an invite link. Groups on a WhatsApp Business app number are excluded, and several credible secondary sources say each group holds at most 8 participants (the business counts as one) and each number can run up to 10,000 groups. So community-style offer groups with hundreds of members have to run in the regular WhatsApp Business app, or on a separate number. The official API should handle the 1:1 AI sales agent and opted-in marketing templates.

Pricing:
- Meta has charged per delivered message since 1 July 2025, based on message category and the recipient's country code.
- Colombia, on the 1 July 2026 card: marketing about USD 0.0125, utility and authentication about USD 0.0008. Colombia is not on the list of markets that change on 1 October 2026. These figures come from secondary sources because Meta's rate-card pages could not be opened.
- One marketing template to 50,000 Colombian numbers costs about 50,000 × 0.0125 = USD 625 (around COP 2.3M). Only delivered messages are billed, and marketing has no volume discounts.
- Urgent, 6 days from today: from 1 October 2026 Meta starts charging for free-form replies inside the 24h window (service messages) at the market's utility rate. Each business phone number gets 1,000 free per month, shared between 1:1 and group sends. Colombia's rate is about USD 0.0008 or COP 2.9455 per message. Utility templates sent inside the window lose their free status, with no free tier. A payment method must be on the WhatsApp account by 30 September 2026, or service messages stop being delivered.
- Click-to-WhatsApp ads and Facebook Page call-to-action buttons stay free: all messages are free for 72h if the business replies within 24h. A wa.me link or QR code is NOT one of these free entry points. It opens a normal 24h window, which becomes paid after the 1,000 free messages from 1 October.

Messaging limits:
- Limits apply per business portfolio (since 7 October 2025) and count unique users reached outside the 24h window in a rolling 24h period.
- A new portfolio starts at 250. It reaches 2,000 through a scaling path, then 10K, 100K or unlimited automatically if quality is high and it uses at least half its limit for 7 days.
- Several partners report that in Q1–Q2 2026 Meta removed the 2K and 10K levels, so a verified business goes straight to 100K. Meta's own "upcoming changes" page could not be read to confirm this.
- Meta also caps how many marketing messages one person can receive from all businesses combined (error 131049; wait 24h before retrying). It doesn't publish the number.
- Large campaigns are sent in batches and paused automatically if people block or report the messages.

Opt-in: the person must have given their number AND opted in to messages from this business, with the business named. The opt-in can come from any channel and doesn't have to mention WhatsApp, but it must comply with local law. Opt-outs must be honoured right away. A past purchase alone is not clearly an opt-in.

Coexistence (the same number on the Business app and the API): partners say it now works in almost every country. Meta publishes no country list, so Colombia is not confirmed. 1:1 chats sync between the app and the API. Groups keep working in the app but never reach the API. Broadcast lists become read-only, throughput is fixed at 20 messages per second, and the app must be opened about every 14 days. Groups API does not work on such a number.

Setup: Business Verification, then display name review, then optionally OBA (needs 30+ days on the platform, 2-step verification and an approved name). The business can connect directly to the Cloud API: access is free, Meta hosts it, and a System User token is used. Or it can go through a Solution Partner, which adds its own fee.

AI rules: WhatsApp's Business Solution Terms ban general-purpose AI assistants as the main product (from 15 January 2026). A store's own sales and order agent counts as incidental, so it is allowed.

Identifiers: from 2026, webhooks carry a business-scoped user ID (BSUID), and users can hide their phone number behind a username.

claims.claim: The Cloud API has a Groups API. To use it the business must be an Official Business Account (OBA). It is not available on WhatsApp Business app numbers or on numbers onboarded to Multi-solution Conversations. Groups are invite-only: people join through an invite link the business sends, and there is no endpoint to add someone directly. Messages go to a group through the Messages API with recipient_type 'group' and the group ID in 'to'. The Calling API does not work in groups.

design_implications: URGENT (deadline 30 September 2026, 5 days away): add a payment method to the WhatsApp Business Account before 30 September, or service messages stop being delivered on 1 October.

Split the system in two. (1) Offer groups larger than 8 people can't run on the official API, so run them in the WhatsApp Business app, either on a separate 'community' number or on the API number through Coexistence. Group activity won't reach the backend either way. (2) Each offer posted in a group carries a wa.me link to the API number with a pre-filled product code, e.g. https://wa.me/57XXXXXXXXXX?text=Quiero%20SKU-123. The customer's first message opens a 24h window, and the Claude agent reads the SKU and runs the order flow.

Budget the 1:1 agent for paid service messages after 1 October 2026. In Colombia each reply costs about USD 0.0008 after the first 1,000 per number per month. Example: a 15-message order chat costs about USD 0.012, so 1,000 orders a month is roughly USD 11. Have the agent send fewer, longer messages. Send the order confirmation inside the window as a service message. Send later shipping updates as utility templates at USD 0.0008.

Do NOT send marketing templates to all 50,000 numbers without opt-in evidence. Build an opt-in table: source, timestamp, the consent text shown, business name, and an opt-out flag. Collect or refresh consent through other channels, through Click-to-WhatsApp ads (72h free), and through wa.me/QR entry points. Stop messaging immediately on STOP or a block.

Roll out marketing gradually, most recent and engaged buyers first, and watch the quality rating and template status through webhooks (account_update and template status). Treat error 131049 as 'do not retry for 24h'. Budget up to USD 625 for a full 50,000-person send at USD 0.0125 each.

Check the current messaging limit in WhatsApp Manager, and read the business_manager messaging-limit field through the API (v24.0+) before planning sends. With a 100K limit after verification, 50K people fit in one day, sent in batches. On the older ladder, plan for 2–4+ weeks of ramp-up.

Store contacts by BSUID (user_id) plus an optional E.164 phone number, not by phone alone. Make incoming webhook handling idempotent and keep the window-open timestamp per contact, so the agent knows when it may send free-form messages and when it must use a template.

Use the direct Cloud API: the stack is in-house (Next.js), so no provider fee. Complete Meta Business Verification with the legal entity's documents and use a display name that matches the store brand. Apply for OBA after 30 days only if the Groups API is still wanted, and remember its groups max out at 8 people.

Keep the Claude agent limited to the store: catalog lookup, price and stock, name and Colombian address, explicit 'CONFIRMO' before creating the Shopify cash-on-delivery order, and handoff to a human. That keeps it clearly on the allowed side of the ban on general-purpose AI assistants.

If the Business app runs on the same number (Coexistence), plan for the 20 messages-per-second throughput cap, read-only broadcast lists, and opening the app at least every ~14 days. A separate app-only number for groups keeps the API number clean.

Colombian law may restrict when commercial messages can be sent (Ley 2300 de 2023: weekday/Saturday hours, no Sundays or holidays), which the legal research topic should confirm. Schedule marketing sends in a scheduler window that can be changed later.
open_questions: Meta's Groups API pages could not be opened, so the 8-participant cap and the 10,000-groups-per-number limit come only from secondary sources. Check the official 'Groups API / Get started' page.

Has the removal of the 2K/10K levels (verified business → 100K immediately) actually reached this portfolio? Check WhatsApp Manager or the whatsapp_business_manager_messaging_limit field after verification.
Exact COP amounts on the Colombian rate card (marketing is about COP 46; service is COP 2.9455 per one source). Download the official rate card CSV from developers.facebook.com in a browser.
Is Coexistence confirmed for Colombian +57 numbers? Only partners say it is available 'worldwide'. Try the Embedded Signup coexistence option to confirm.
How many of the 50,000 numbers have documented consent that names the store? If none, a re-consent strategy is needed before any template campaign.

Are Cloud API 'address messages' (native address form) available for Colombia? They appear limited to India and Singapore. If not, collect the address in free text or with WhatsApp Flows and validate it on the backend.

What is the member limit for groups in the regular WhatsApp app (commonly cited as 1,024)? Is there an official API for posting to WhatsApp Channels? Only unofficial tools like Whapi were found, and those carry ban risk.
Does Colombia's Ley 2300 de 2023 (contact hours and frequency) apply to e-commerce WhatsApp marketing? This belongs to the Colombian law research topic.
Is Groups API still in any beta or rate-limited state for new Official Business Accounts, and does Meta cap how many invite links can be sent per day?

resultado.summary:
Evolution API has moved from github.com/EvolutionAPI to github.com/evolution-foundation/evolution-api. The latest stable release is v2.3.7 (2025-12-05), and GitHub's "Latest" link still points to it. v2.4.0-rc1 (2026-05-06) and 2.4.0-rc2 (2026-05-17) are pre-releases built from the develop branch. Develop kept moving until 2026-07-14: Baileys 7.0.0-rc13, Prisma 7, Express 5, and a new EVOHUB channel that proxies the Meta Cloud API. The biggest change in 2.4.0 is a breaking one: every server must be activated against the Evolution Foundation licensing server. Until it is, every business endpoint returns HTTP 503 LICENSE_REQUIRED, and after activation the server sends a heartbeat every 30 minutes. The license is Apache-2.0 plus two brand conditions: keep the logo, and show a notice that Evolution API is in use.

The REST API is the same in 2.3.7 and develop:
- Auth is an `apikey` header, which takes either the global AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY or the instance's own token.
- Send text: `POST /message/sendText/{instance}` with `{number, text, ...}`. To post in a group, put the group JID (`1203...@g.us`) in `number`.
- Groups: `POST /group/create/{instance}`, `GET /group/inviteCode/{instance}?groupJid=`, `POST /group/updateSetting/{instance}?groupJid=` with `{"action":"announcement"}`, `GET /group/participants/{instance}?groupJid=`, and `POST /group/updateParticipant/{instance}?groupJid=` with `{"action":"remove","participants":[...]}`.

Webhooks:
- Configure with `POST /webhook/set/{instance}`, body `{"webhook":{...}}`.
- Every event arrives in the envelope `{event, instance, data, destination, date_time, sender, server_url, apikey}`.
- In `messages.upsert`, Evolution rewrites extendedTextMessage into `data.message.conversation` with `messageType:"conversation"`. Read text from there.
- Group messages have `key.remoteJid` ending in `@g.us`, and `key.participant` is the sender. With Baileys v7 the sender may be an `@lid` ID, and `key.participantAlt` then holds the phone-number JID.
- Messages sent through the API come back as `send.message`, not `messages.upsert` (emitOwnEvents is false). Messages typed on the phone arrive as `messages.upsert` with `fromMe:true`.
- Joins and leaves arrive as `group-participants.update` with `{id, participants, action, participantsData}`. Joins by invite link are `add`; leaves and removals are both `remove`.

Evolution can also connect to the official Cloud API (`integration: "WHATSAPP-BUSINESS"`, where `number` is the phone_number_id and `token` is a permanent Meta token). Incoming Meta webhooks go to `{SERVER_URL}/webhook/meta` and are converted into the same `messages.upsert` shape. In that mode, however, every group endpoint throws "Method not available on WhatsApp Business API". So Evolution can only run the promo groups on the unofficial Baileys (WhatsApp Web) engine.

On ban risk, Baileys' own README says it is not authorized by WhatsApp and discourages "bulk or automated messaging". WhatsApp's help center says unofficial apps violate its Terms and can get accounts banned; I could only see this through search snippets because whatsapp.com was blocked. Evolution's issue tracker has 2025-2026 reports of:
- 24h restrictions with the message "unofficial application detected", even for inbound-only customer service on a VPS (#2693, Aug 2026)
- numbers banned right after scanning the QR code (#2497)
- bans from checking many numbers in bulk (#2228)

Evolution has no built-in limit or queue for outgoing messages (#2538, closed as not planned).

My take: Baileys-based groups built from 50k leads carry a real, unpredictable ban risk and break WhatsApp's Terms. The compliant route is the Cloud API for the 1:1 AI-agent ordering flow. Evolution does support that route, but without groups.

design_implications: Do not rely on Evolution's WHATSAPP-BUSINESS mode for groups: every group method throws. Split the design. Run the 1:1 AI ordering agent on the official Cloud API, either direct from Next.js or through Evolution's WHATSAPP-BUSINESS mode. Treat promo groups as a separate, higher-risk channel.

If you run promo groups on Baileys anyway, use a dedicated, disposable number that is not your main sales line. Expect restrictions such as 401 device_removed and 24h blocks. Keep the ordering flow on a separate number so a ban cannot take it down.

Never use /group/create or /group/updateParticipant with action 'add' to put leads into groups, and never use /group/sendInvite to push links to all 50k numbers. That is bulk automated messaging, which WhatsApp's Terms prohibit and which gets numbers banned. Share the chat.whatsapp.com invite link from GET /group/inviteCode through opt-in channels instead (site, Instagram, order confirmations), and let people join on their own.
Do not validate the 50k list with /chat/whatsappNumbers or by sending test messages. Each uncached send already triggers an onWhatsApp lookup.

Set promo groups to announcement mode with POST /group/updateSetting ?groupJid=...@g.us {"action":"announcement"}, plus 'locked'. Customers then cannot post, and the bot never has to parse group chatter.

In the Next.js webhook handler, read text from data.message.conversation, which covers extendedTextMessage as well. Check data.key.remoteJid.endsWith('@g.us') to detect groups, and ignore data.key.fromMe === true. Deduplicate on data.key.id, because Evolution retries delivery up to 10 times on non-4xx errors. Return 2xx quickly and hand the work to a queue.

Resolve a customer's identity from the phone number, not the LID. In DMs Evolution already swaps @lid for the phone-number JID and keeps the LID in key.remoteJidAlt. In groups use key.participantAlt when key.participant ends with @lid. Store both.

Parse GROUP_PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE defensively. data.participants may hold strings or Baileys v7 objects {id, phoneNumber, lid}, and participantsData.phoneNumber may be wrong. 'add' covers invite-link joins; 'remove' covers both leaving and being removed.

Secure the webhook endpoint. Set webhook.headers {"jwt_key":"<secret>"} so Evolution sends an HS256 Bearer JWT, and verify it, or use a static secret header. Evolution does not sign payloads. For the Cloud API, point Meta's webhook straight at Next.js so you can verify X-Hub-Signature-256; Evolution's /webhook/meta does not check it.

Version pinning: the 2.3.7 image has no license gate but lacks the cross-instance auth fix. 2.4.0-rc and develop need license activation (a phone-home heartbeat every 30 minutes). Pin an exact image tag, keep Evolution on a private network behind your Next.js backend, use only the global API key, and put an adapter interface around the WhatsApp provider so you can swap it (Cloud API direct, Evolution, or evolution-go).
Add the Evolution API usage notice to your admin/settings page to meet the LICENSE's extra condition.
Build your own outbound queue with per-number rate limits, jitter and daily caps. Evolution has none, and `delay` only simulates typing for a single request.
If using WHATSAPP-BUSINESS mode, set WA_BUSINESS_VERSION to a current Graph API version. The example still says v18.0.
open_questions: Is the Evolution Foundation license activation really free for self-hosted use, what telemetry does the heartbeat send, and what are the terms? The licensing docs domain was blocked; only a search snippet says community tiers are free.
Will 2.4.0 final ship (only rc1 and rc2 are tagged; the last develop commit is 2026-07-14), and will the auth-bypass fix be backported to a 2.3.x tag?

Meta's Cloud API may now offer a Groups API. Evolution does not wrap one, and I could not open developers.facebook.com to confirm its existence, limits (size, invite-link joins, announcement mode) or pricing for promo groups.
What group size limits, invite-link join rate limits and admin limits does WhatsApp enforce today? I found no primary source.
Does Evolution's group-participants.update enrichment actually break with Baileys v7 object participants? This is inferred from code and should be confirmed by capturing a real webhook in staging.
WhatsApp's current Terms, Business Messaging Policy and Help Center text could not be opened directly (whatsapp.com blocked). Re-verify the exact wording and dates before any legal decision.
Is Evolution's evolution-go (whatsmeow-based) implementation any safer from bans than Baileys? Nothing in these sources suggests it is, since both are unofficial clients.

resultado.summary:
This is research, not legal advice. Every source was checked only through search-engine extracts. WebFetch and curl were blocked for all domains, so I could not open any page. The web-search budget also ran out, so confidence is capped at medium (see tool_problems).

Bottom line: DV Digital can legally run WhatsApp promotions in Colombia only to people who gave marketing consent that can be proved. Messages must go out in the allowed hours and must not reach numbers on the CRC exclusion registry (RNE). Using the 50,000 numbers as they stand is high-risk.

1) Ley 1581/2012 and Decreto 1377/2013 (compiled in DUR 1074/2015, section 2.2.2.25):
- Consent must be prior, express and informed (Art. 3). It must be obtained by a means that can be checked later (Art. 9).
- It can be given in writing, orally or by unequivocal conduct. Silence never counts (D.1377 Art. 7 / 2.2.2.25.2.4).
- The responsable must keep proof of it (Art. 17(b); D.1377 Art. 8 / 2.2.2.25.2.5).
- Consent can be revoked at any time through a free, easy mechanism (2.2.2.25.2.6).
- When asking for consent, the store must state the purpose (finalidad), the holder's rights and its own contact details (Art. 12).
- Fines go up to 2,000 SMMLV and can repeat while the breach continues; there are also suspension and closure (Art. 23).
- In October 2025 the SIC confirmed a COP 670M fine against Movistar for SMS, WhatsApp and calls sent without that kind of consent.

2) Ley 2300/2023 ("Dejen de fregar"):
- Art. 5 applies the law "en los mismos términos" to advertising by any producer or supplier sent by SMS, "mensajería por aplicaciones o web", email or calls. That covers WhatsApp.
- Advertising may only be sent in the Art. 3 hours: Mon–Fri 7:00–19:00, Sat 8:00–15:00, never on Sundays or holidays.
- The sender must provide a quick, simple way to stop receiving messages. A promotion used to feed a database must be explicitly accepted.
- Art. 3 also has a frequency limit: no several channels in the same week and no more than one contact per day. The text is written for debt collectors. Whether it also binds advertising is unclear, so apply it conservatively.
- In force since 10 Oct 2023; the Constitutional Court upheld it (C-278/24).
- SIC Circular Externa 001 (26 Jun 2024) requires suppliers to check the CRC's RNE registry before sending advertising. Registering there counts as revoking earlier consent. CRC Res. 7356/2024 extended the registry to messaging apps.

3) WhatsApp groups: I found no SIC ruling on commercial groups where members see each other's numbers.
- Ley 1581 Art. 4 says personal data may not be "divulgados sin previa autorización" and sets restricted circulation.
- SIC Circular Externa 002/2026, written for elections, says people may not be added to WhatsApp groups or lists without prior informed consent. It also rules out using third-party or scraped databases without checking consent.
- My inference: an ordinary group that shows numbers to strangers is a disclosure that needs specific consent. Prefer formats that hide numbers, or 1:1 messages to people who opted in.

4) Purchased or scraped lists are not acceptable. On top of the Ley 1581 violation, buying or selling personal data without authorization can be a crime under Código Penal Art. 269F: 48–96 months in prison.

5) Existing customers: consent given for delivering an order does not automatically cover marketing (the finalidad principle). Ley 2300 Art. 5 Par. 1 says a purchase cannot force the buyer to accept commercial messages. Most of the 50,000 numbers probably need to be asked again for permission.

claims.claim: Ley 1581 de 2012 requires 'autorización' for processing personal data (phone numbers included). Art. 3 defines it as 'Consentimiento previo, expreso e informado del Titular'. Art. 9 requires it to be obtained 'por cualquier medio que pueda ser objeto de consulta posterior', so consent must be recorded in a form that can be checked later. Exceptions are only those in the law (Art. 10). I did not check Art. 10 in this session, but as far as I know it has no general 'marketing' or 'existing customer' exception.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: Artículo 9°. Autorización del Titular. Sin perjuicio de las excepciones previstas en la ley, en el Tratamiento se requiere la autorización previa e informada del Titular, la cual deberá ser obtenida por cualquier medio que pueda ser objeto de consulta posterior.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 - Secretaría del Senado
sources.quote: Autorización: Consentimiento previo, expreso e informado del Titular para llevar a cabo el Tratamiento de datos personales.

claims.claim: Consent can be given in writing, orally or by 'conductas inequívocas', but silence never counts (Decreto 1377/2013 Art. 7, compiled as DUR 1074/2015 Art. 2.2.2.25.2.4). The responsable must keep proof of it (Decreto 1377 Art. 8 = DUR Art. 2.2.2.25.2.5; Ley 1581 Art. 17(b) 'Solicitar y conservar ... copia de la respectiva autorización'). So adding someone to a group or list and treating 'didn't leave / didn't reply' as consent is not valid. A WhatsApp reply such as 'SÍ, acepto' to a clear notice, stored with its timestamp, can serve as proof.

sources.title: Decreto 1377 de 2013 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: En ningún caso el silencio podrá asimilarse a una conducta inequívoca.

sources.title: Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Parte 2, Título 2, Capítulo 25) - Normograma Cancillería
sources.quote: Artículo 2.2.2.25.2.5 PRUEBA DE LA AUTORIZACIÓN. Los Responsables deberán conservar prueba de la autorización otorgada por los Titulares de datos personales para el Tratamiento de los mismos.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 - Art. 17 Deberes de los Responsables
sources.quote: Solicitar y conservar, en las condiciones previstas en la presente ley, copia de la respectiva autorización otorgada por el Titular.

claims.claim: When asking for consent, Ley 1581 Art. 12 requires the store to state clearly and expressly: (a) how the data will be processed and for what purpose; (b) that answering questions on sensitive data or minors' data is optional; (c) the holder's rights (the extract I saw left out (c); it is from my knowledge of the text); (d) the responsable's identity, physical or electronic address and phone number. The responsable must keep proof that it gave this information. This sets the minimum content of the first opt-in message. Art. 4(b) (finalidad) requires the purpose to be legitimate and disclosed.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 - Art. 12 Deber de informar al Titular
sources.quote: El Tratamiento al cual serán sometidos sus datos personales y la finalidad del mismo ... La identificación, dirección física o electrónica y teléfono del Responsable del Tratamiento.

sources.title: Art. 12 Ley 1581 de 2012 - Deber de informar al titular (secondary mirror)

claims.claim: Revocation: holders may at any time ask for their data to be deleted and/or revoke consent, through a claim under Ley 1581 Art. 15. The responsable must provide free, easily accessible ways to do this (DUR 1074 Art. 2.2.2.25.2.6, ex-Decreto 1377 Art. 9). For advertising, Ley 2300 also requires the sender to provide 'un mecanismo ágil, sencillo y eficiente para cancelar en cualquier momento la recepción de mensajes'. This is Art. 5 Par. 2 in my reading; one extract placed it in Art. 4, so the numbering is unconfirmed.

sources.title: Decreto 1074 de 2015 - Art. 2.2.2.25.2.6 Revocatoria de la autorización y/o supresión del dato
sources.quote: Los Titulares podrán en todo momento solicitar al responsable o encargado la supresión de sus datos personales y/o revocar la autorización otorgada para el Tratamiento de los mismos, mediante la presentación de un reclamo, de acuerdo con lo establecido en el artículo 15 de la Ley 1581 de 2012.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: El emisor del mensaje deberá habilitar y disponer de un mecanismo ágil, sencillo y eficiente para cancelar en cualquier momento la recepción de mensajes y correos

claims.claim: Ley 2300 de 2023 covers WhatsApp advertising by any store, not just debt collectors. Art. 5 extends the law 'en los mismos términos' to producers and suppliers sending advertising by SMS, 'mensajería por aplicaciones o web', email and calls. Art. 5 Par. 3 limits such advertising to the Art. 3 hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m., Sat 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., and never on Sundays or public holidays.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: En todo caso el envío de mensajes publicitarios a través de Mensajes Cortos de Texto (SMS), mensajería por aplicaciones o web, correos electrónicos y que realicen llamadas telefónicas de carácter comercial o publicitario, solo podrán hacerlo por dentro de los horarios establecidos en el artículo 3o.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Secretaría del Senado
sources.quote: dentro del horario de lunes a viernes y de 7:00 a. m. a 7:00 p. m., y sábados de 8:00 a. m. a 3:00 p. m., excluyendo cualquier tipo de contacto con el consumidor los domingos y días festivos.

sources.title: LEY 2300 DE 2023 - SUIN Juriscol
sources.quote: Lo dispuesto en la presente ley se aplicará en los mismos términos a las relaciones comerciales entre los productores y proveedores de bienes y servicios privados o públicos y el consumidor comercial frente al envío de mensajes publicitarios

claims.claim: It is unclear whether the frequency limit binds advertising. Art. 3 says that once direct contact exists, the consumer may not be contacted by collection agents through several channels in the same week, nor more than once on the same day. That wording is addressed to 'gestores de cobranza'. Art. 5 Par. 3 expressly imports only the hours, but Art. 5 itself applies 'lo dispuesto en la presente ley ... en los mismos términos' to advertising. Similarly, Art. 2 (contact only through channels the consumer authorized) is written for collection but is commonly read as covering advertising too. I found no SIC text that settles either point. Conservative reading: at most one promotional message per person per day, one channel per week, and only on the channel the person authorized.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: Una vez establecido un contacto directo con el consumidor, este no podrá ser contactado por parte de gestores de cobranza mediante varios canales dentro de una misma semana ni en más de una ocasión durante el mismo día.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Art. 2 Canales autorizados
sources.quote: sólo podrán contactar a los consumidores mediante los canales que estos autoricen para tal efecto

claims.claim: Ley 2300 Art. 5 Par. 1: a purchase cannot oblige the consumer to accept commercial messages, except those strictly related to what was bought. Promotions used to feed databases must be known to and explicitly accepted by the consumer. So Shopify COD buyers whose numbers were collected for delivery cannot be assumed to have accepted promotional WhatsApp messages.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública
sources.quote: Cuando se trate de promociones para alimentar bases de datos, el consumidor deberá saberlo y aceptarlo de manera explícita.

claims.claim: Ley 2300 was promulgated on 10 July 2023 (Diario Oficial 52.452). It took effect three months later (about 10 Oct 2023). The Constitutional Court upheld it in Sentencia C-278/24 (July 2024). I found no amendment through Sept 2026, but my search was limited.

sources.title: Ley 2300 de 2023 - Secretaría del Senado (vigencia)
sources.quote: La presente ley entrará en vigor en un plazo de tres (3) meses contados a partir de su promulgación y deroga las disposiciones que le sean contrarias.

sources.title: Infobae - Ley 'dejen de fregar' respaldada por la Corte Constitucional (C-278/24)

claims.claim: Exclusion registry (RNE): CRC Resolución 7356 of 10 April 2024 amended the RNE rules (Res. CRC 5050/2016, Title II, Ch. 1) to follow Ley 2300. Consumers can now opt out of advertising by SMS, messaging apps or web, email and calls. SIC Circular Externa 001 of 26 June 2024, section IV, requires producers and suppliers to check the RNE and not send advertising to registered holders. It treats RNE registration as revoking any earlier marketing consent. Contact can resume only after the store obtains new consent dated after the registration. Breaches can lead to fines of up to 2,000 SMMLV, suspension of up to 6 months, and closure.

sources.title: Circular Externa 1 de 2024 SIC - Sede Electrónica
Garrigues - Colombia: las empresas deberán consultar el Registro de Números Excluidos antes de enviar contenidos publicitarios
sources.quote: producers and suppliers of goods and services are required to consult the Registro de Números Excluidos (RNE) ... refraining from sending advertising or commercial content to those who have requested exclusion (search extract, paraphrased)

sources.title: Lloreda Camacho - SIC guidelines on its jurisdiction under Law 2300 of 2023
sources.quote: If a data subject registers within the RNE after giving an authorization to receive marketing or advertisement communications, this register must be understood as a revocation of such authorization.

claims.claim: Per SIC Circular 001/2024, as summarized by Lloreda Camacho: the SIC enforces Ley 2300 marketing contact when it also affects habeas data (consent, authorized channels, purposes, the RNE). A breach that affects only the separate right to privacy falls outside its jurisdiction. This means an hours-only violation might be pursued elsewhere, for example by tutela. It does not reduce the need to comply.

sources.title: Lloreda Camacho - SIC guidelines on its jurisdiction under Law 2300
sources.quote: SIC has jurisdiction if it involves a violation of both the consumers' right to privacy and their right to habeas data as a whole; while where the autonomous right to privacy is involved, such enforcement falls outside of SIC's jurisdiction.

sources.title: SIC Circular Externa 001 de 26 de junio de 2024 (PDF)
Ley 1581 de 2012 - Art. 23 Sanciones
sources.quote: Multas de carácter personal e institucional hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes al momento de la imposición de la sanción.

sources.title: Holland & Knight - Colombia decreta aumento del salario mínimo 2026
Holland & Knight - Suspensión provisional del decreto que fijó el salario mínimo 2026

claims.claim: Recent enforcement on WhatsApp marketing: in SIC Resolución 78138 of 2 Oct 2025, the SIC's data protection division confirmed a COP 670 million fine against Colombia Telecomunicaciones (Movistar). The company had repeatedly contacted people by SMS, WhatsApp and calls for marketing without their prior, express and informed consent. The SIC said such prospecting 'vulnera el derecho fundamental al habeas data'.

sources.title: La SIC sanciona a Movistar por tratamiento indebido de datos personales con fines de prospección comercial - SIC Sede Electrónica
sources.quote: Las actividades de prospección comercial mediante el envío de mensajes de texto, el uso de aplicaciones o la realización de llamadas telefónicas sin contar con la autorización previa, expresa e informada de los titulares vulnera el derecho fundamental al habeas data

sources.title: Infobae - Sancionada Movistar por enviar mensajes sin consentimiento

claims.claim: The SIC's latest reading on WhatsApp groups comes from SIC Circular Externa 002 de 2026 (electoral data), issued around January 2026 after a December 2025 draft. It says no one may be added to instant-messaging groups (WhatsApp, Telegram), distribution lists or mass mailings without prior, express and informed consent. It also rules out contacting people from databases acquired from third parties or scraped, without first checking consent. Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it. The circular is limited to elections, but it applies Ley 1581, so the same logic very likely applies to commercial groups.

sources.title: La SIC expidió instrucciones sobre protección de datos personales en el contexto electoral - SIC
Presidencia - SIC estableció normas de obligatorio cumplimiento ... época electoral
SIC on X - nadie puede incluirte en grupos o listas de difusión sin autorización
sources.quote: La SIC recordó que nadie puede incluirte en grupos o listas de difusión sin autorización

sources.title: Infobae - Agregarlo a grupos de WhatsApp sin su permiso es ilegal: nueva circular de la SIC

claims.claim: WhatsApp groups where members can see each other's numbers: Ley 1581 Art. 4(c) (libertad) says personal data may not be 'divulgados sin previa autorización'. Art. 4(f) (restricted circulation) limits availability through mass-communication media. Putting hundreds of customers into an ordinary group exposes each member's number to all the others. That is very likely a disclosure to third parties which the member's consent must expressly cover. This is my inference; I found no SIC decision specifically on commercial promo groups.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 - Art. 4 principios
sources.quote: El Tratamiento sólo puede ejercerse con el consentimiento, previo, expreso e informado del Titular. Los datos personales no podrán ser obtenidos o divulgados sin previa autorización, o en ausencia de mandato legal o judicial que releve el consentimiento.

claims.claim: Purchased or scraped lists: apart from failing Ley 1581 Art. 9 and the SIC's position in c13, Código Penal Art. 269F (added by Ley 1273/2009, 'violación de datos personales') covers anyone who, without authorization and for their own or a third party's profit, obtains, compiles, offers, sells, exchanges, buys or uses personal data held in databases. The penalty is 48–96 months in prison and fines of 100–1,000 SMMLV. The store should use only its own customers or leads with provable consent.

sources.title: PPU Legal - El delito de violación de datos personales en Colombia

claims.claim: Registering databases with the SIC's national registry (RNBD) is required only of companies and non-profits with total assets above 100,000 UVT (Decreto 090 de 2018), plus public entities. At the 2026 UVT of COP 52,374 that is about COP 5.24 billion, so a small store is probably exempt. All other Ley 1581 duties still apply.

sources.title: Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos - SIC

claims.claim: Data-processing policy and privacy notice: Decreto 1377 Arts. 13–15 (DUR 1074 Arts. 2.2.2.25.3.1–2.2.2.25.3.3) require a written 'política de tratamiento'. It must cover identity and contact details, purposes, rights, the area that handles claims, the procedure for access, correction, deletion and revocation, and the policy's effective date. Where the full policy cannot be made available, a shorter 'aviso de privacidad' must be given that points to it. I could not check the exact wording or article mapping in this session, so treat it as indicative.

sources.title: Decreto 1377 de 2013 - Gestor Normativo - Función Pública

claims.claim: A statutory bill to overhaul Ley 1581, closer to GDPR and LGPD (reported as Proyecto de Ley Estatutaria 282 de 2026 Cámara), was filed by the SIC, MinCiencias and the Procuraduría. As of the sources found it was still a bill. A statutory law also needs prior Constitutional Court review, so Ley 1581 as it stands should be assumed to govern in Sept 2026. Its status should be re-checked.

sources.title: ABC del Proyecto de Ley de Protección de Datos Personales en Colombia - SIC
CiberLATAM - Colombia reforma la Ley 1581 con Proyecto 282

design_implications:
OPT-OUT:
- Recognize keywords at any time: BAJA, STOP, NO, 'no quiero más', 'salir'.
- Also offer a quick-reply button in every promo template.
- Revoke immediately: remove the person from all groups and broadcast lists, send one confirmation, then stop.
- A holder's registration in the RNE counts as a revocation. Re-sync the RNE before each campaign.
- Log every revocation.
- Handle requests to access or delete data within legal deadlines. The consultas/reclamos deadlines in Ley 1581 Arts. 14–15 are commonly cited as 10 and 15 business days; I did not verify them in this session.

THE 50,000 LEGACY NUMBERS:
- Do not add them to groups or send promotions without proof of consent.
- Split them into: (a) numbers whose checkout or other consent text explicitly covered marketing by WhatsApp, which are usable after an RNE check; (b) buyers whose numbers were collected only for delivery, who need new consent; (c) any purchased or scraped numbers, which should be deleted.
- For (b), prefer consent collected where the customer starts the contact: an 'Únete a ofertas' link or QR code on packages, Instagram, the website, the order-confirmation page, or delivery messages.
- A one-time permission-request message to past buyers is a legal grey area. It must be non-promotional, sent within the hours, only to numbers not in the RNE, with an easy 'no' option. Get a Colombian lawyer's sign-off first.

FIRST OPT-IN MESSAGE: required content per Ley 1581 Art. 12 and Ley 2300.
- Who: DV Digital legal name, NIT, email and phone.
- Purpose: send offers and promotions from the store by WhatsApp; if they join a group or channel, whether other members can see their number.
- Their rights: know, update, correct, delete, revoke.
- How to opt out at any time: reply BAJA.
- A link to the política de tratamiento.
- An explicit action to accept: 'Responde SÍ para aceptar'. Silence is not consent.
Store the version shown alongside the reply.

GROUP FORMAT:
- Avoid ordinary WhatsApp groups where members see each other's numbers (a likely disclosure to third parties under Ley 1581 Art. 4(c)/(f)).
- Prefer one-to-many formats that hide member numbers, such as WhatsApp Channels or Community announcement groups; check the current privacy behavior in the WhatsApp research topic.
- Or send 1:1 template broadcasts through the official WhatsApp Business Platform to opted-in contacts only.
- If ordinary groups are used anyway, get specific consent that the number will be visible to other members. Make admins the only posters.

AI ORDER AGENT (COD): collecting name, address and phone in chat is processing that needs its own consent. As far as I know, Ley 1581 Art. 10 has no general 'contract performance' exception; I did not verify this in this session.
- Before asking for the address, show a short privacy notice with the policy link and get an 'Acepto'.
- Record it as an ORDER_PROCESSING consent separate from PROMO consent.
- Do not treat order consent as marketing consent.
- Give the customer a summary of the data used and get their explicit confirmation before creating the Shopify order.

Publish a política de tratamiento de datos on the Shopify store (Decreto 1377 Arts. 13–15) and link it from every opt-in. Name who handles claims. Keep an internal procedures manual. The RNBD registration is probably not required below 100,000 UVT in assets.

Never import purchased or scraped lists into the system. This risks both administrative sanctions under Ley 1581 and criminal liability under Código Penal Art. 269F. Enforce it technically: every contact must have a consent-event source, and bulk CSV imports without a consent reference should be blocked.
open_questions: Does the Ley 2300 Art. 3 frequency limit (not several channels in the same week, not more than once a day) apply to advertising, via the Art. 5 'en los mismos términos' clause, or only to debt collection? I found no official SIC guidance.

Does posting an offer in a WhatsApp group or Channel that the person voluntarily joined count as 'envío de mensajes publicitarios' under Ley 2300? If so, the Art. 3 hours and the RNE check apply to it. It probably does.
Can a one-time, non-promotional message asking for marketing consent be sent lawfully to past COD buyers whose numbers were collected only for delivery? Legal opinion needed.

How does a small supplier get access to the CRC RNE platform, how often must it be checked, and at what cost? Res. CRC 7356/2024 and SIC Circular 001/2024 could not be opened to confirm the operational details.

What exactly does Decreto 1377 Arts. 13–15 require in the política de tratamiento and aviso de privacidad, and what are the Ley 1581 Arts. 14–15 response deadlines? Neither could be verified this session.

Is there any SIC ruling or concept on commercial WhatsApp groups where members' numbers are visible? None was found. The group-disclosure analysis is an inference from Ley 1581 Art. 4 and the electoral Circular 002/2026.
What is the 2026 peso value of the Ley 1581 fine cap, given the UVT conversion under Ley 1955 Art. 49 and the pending Consejo de Estado case on the 2026 minimum wage?
What is the status of the Ley 1581 reform bill (reported as PLE 282/2026 Cámara) as of Sept 2026?

Since the store is run by a Brazilian owner, is it constituted in Colombia or abroad? Ley 1581 Art. 2 territorial scope, and who is the legal 'responsable', affect whose name, NIT and contact details go in the notices.

For these reasons no claim is marked high confidence, and all statute quotes should be re-checked against secretariasenado.gov.co or funcionpublica.gov.co before relying on them.

resultado.summary:
I could not reach shopify.dev, help.shopify.com or shopify.com (the egress proxy blocked them), and the web-search budget was already used up. Instead I read Shopify's own machine-readable sources: the official @shopify/dev-mcp npm package (v1.15.4, published 2026-09-18), @shopify/shopify-api 15.0.0 (2026-09-17), and Shopify-owned GitHub repos (worldwide, lighthouse-ci-action, claude-for-commerce-examples, shopify-app-js). The dev-mcp package bundles the full Admin GraphQL introspection schemas. Their descriptions are the reference text shown on shopify.dev, and each field lists the access scope it needs.

1) API version: Admin GraphQL 2026-07 is the latest stable version. 2026-10 is a release candidate, and the supported stable versions are 2025-10 through 2026-07. Pin 2026-07; the orderCreate and draft-order inputs are unchanged in 2026-10.

2) Order creation: `orderCreate(order: OrderCreateOrderInput!, options: OrderCreateOptionsInput)` needs `write_orders` and an offline token. It accepts lineItems (variantId, quantity, priceSet, requiresShipping), customer (toAssociate/toUpsert), shippingAddress, financialStatus PENDING, transactions (gateway, kind, status, amountSet), sourceIdentifier, tags, note and customAttributes. Four defaults must be overridden for COD:
- `inventoryBehaviour` defaults to BYPASS, which does not decrement stock. Set DECREMENT_OBEYING_POLICY.
- A transaction's `status` defaults to SUCCESS. A COD transaction must be sent with status PENDING, or left out.
- A line item's `requiresShipping` defaults to false.
- `sendReceipt` defaults to false, which is fine here.
orderCreate does not apply automatic discounts and does not support an idempotency key. The alternative, draftOrderCreate plus draftOrderComplete(paymentPending: true), takes price and shipping from the variant, offers draftOrderCalculate for quotes, and reserves inventory on completion. It costs two calls and needs `write_draft_orders`. Both paths produce a real order, so the `orders/create` webhook fires ("Occurs whenever an order is created"). Whether Dropi picks these orders up could not be verified.

3) Access token: Shopify-owned repos say that since January 1, 2026, new custom apps cannot be created in the store admin (existing ones keep working). New apps are made in the Dev Dashboard. A backend on the merchant's own store uses the client-credentials grant: POST /admin/oauth/access_token. The token lasts 24 hours and has no refresh token. It only works when the app and the shop are in the same Organization; otherwise Shopify returns `shop_not_permitted`. Protected customer data is a major risk: third-party code quotes a Shopify error saying names, addresses, emails and phone numbers are only available on the Shopify, Advanced and Plus plans.

4) Products and stock: read ProductVariant price, compareAtPrice, inventoryQuantity ("total sellable quantity"), availableForSale, inventoryPolicy and media. `image` and `images` are deprecated. Per-location stock comes from inventoryItem.inventoryLevels.quantities(names:["available"]). Rate limits use a cost-based bucket reported in extensions.cost.throttleStatus.

5) Customers: look up with customerByIdentifier(identifier:{phoneNumber}) or customers(query:"phone:+57…"). Customer.phone is deprecated in favour of defaultPhoneNumber. Phones are unique and in E.164 format. New in 2026-07: a WhatsApp marketing consent field, a mutation to update it, and a webhook topic for it.

6) Colombia addresses: countryCode CO. provinceCode uses Shopify zone codes (DC, ANT, VAC, CUN, ATL, …). Zip is only "recommended" (6 digits). address2 is the unit line plus barrio. The street number is required.

7) Webhooks: verify X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 (base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, keyed with the app's client secret). Deduplicate on X-Shopify-Webhook-Id. Subscribe with the `uri` field; `callbackUrl` is deprecated.

claims.claim: As of 2026-09-18, Shopify lists Admin GraphQL 2026-07 as the latest stable version and 2026-10 as the release candidate. Supported stable versions are 2026-07, 2026-04, 2026-01 and 2025-10, plus 'unstable'. Versions are named quarterly (YYYY-01/04/07/10). Shopify's own Claude commerce example pins 2026-07. 2026-10 should become stable around the start of October 2026, and 2025-10 is the next to fall out of support. That timing assumes Shopify's usual 12-month window; I could not open the versioning page to confirm it.

claims.claim: orderCreate is the direct way to create an order from an external agent. It needs the write_orders scope and works only with offline tokens. Its input includes lineItems, customer, shippingAddress, financialStatus, transactions, shippingLines, sourceIdentifier, tags, note, customAttributes, phone, email, taxesIncluded and taxLines. Automatic discounts are not applied, and only one discount code is allowed. On trial or development stores it is capped at 5 new orders per minute.

Also: This mutation is only accessible to apps authenticated using [offline tokens]" | "Use the `orderCreate` mutation to programmatically generate orders in scenarios where orders aren't created through the standard checkout process" | "Automatic discounts won't be applied unless you replicate the logic of those discounts in your custom implementation." | "If you're using the `orderCreate` mutation with a trial or development store, then you can create a maximum of five new orders per minute."

claims.claim: By default orderCreate does NOT decrement inventory. OrderCreateOptionsInput.inventoryBehaviour defaults to BYPASS ('Do not claim inventory'). To follow the product's inventory policy and decrement stock, pass DECREMENT_OBEYING_POLICY. sendReceipt and sendFulfillmentReceipt both default to false, so Shopify sends no confirmation email; the WhatsApp agent can send the confirmation itself.

claims.claim: COD payment state. Set financialStatus to PENDING; Shopify says it 'Can only be set when the order is created'. Transactions (OrderCreateOrderTransactionInput) default to kind=SALE and status=SUCCESS, so a COD transaction must say status: PENDING explicitly, or be omitted. Otherwise the order records a successful payment. 'gateway' is a free-text name. Shopify's schema gives 'Cash on Delivery (COD)' as an example value of Order.paymentGatewayNames. In Shopify's REST example of a pending order with no transactions, payment_gateway_names comes back empty. So include a PENDING transaction with gateway 'Cash on Delivery (COD)' if downstream tools filter on gateway name. That last point is an inference; test it on a dev store.

claims.claim: orderCreate line items (OrderCreateLineItemInput): quantity is the only required field. variantId links the line to the catalog. priceSet is a MoneyBagInput holding shopMoney {amount, currencyCode}. requiresShipping defaults to false and taxable defaults to true. Order-level taxesIncluded defaults to false, and tax lines can be set on the order or on the lines, but not both. Shipping is added through shippingLines (title and priceSet are required). A community Colombian WhatsApp COD agent claims that lines with a variantId inherit requiresShipping from the variant. That contradicts the schema default, so send requiresShipping: true explicitly.

claims.claim: The alternative is draftOrderCreate followed by draftOrderComplete(id, paymentPending: true, paymentGatewayId?, sourceName?). Inventory is reserved when the draft is completed. Draft line items with a variantId take their title and requiresShipping from the variant, and a priceOverride can be set. Drafts can accept automatic discounts (acceptAutomaticDiscounts). draftOrderCalculate previews taxes, shipping and totals without creating anything, which is useful for quoting before the customer confirms. Scopes: write_draft_orders for both steps, and completing needs permission to mark as paid or set payment terms. paymentPending defaults to false.

claims.claim: Legacy custom apps (created in the Shopify admin, with an Admin API token shown once) cannot be created any more as of January 1, 2026. Existing ones keep working. New integrations must create the app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard, which issues a client ID and secret, not a static token.

sources.quote: ### Dev Dashboard App (recommended — required for apps created after Jan 2026) ... > As of January 1, 2026 Shopify no longer allows creating new custom apps. Existing custom apps continue to work with this method.

claims.claim: How to get a token from a Dev Dashboard app: use the client credentials grant. POST https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token with grant_type=client_credentials, client_id and client_secret. The token lasts 24 hours, carries no refresh token, and has no associated user, so the library treats it as an offline session. The grant only works when the app belongs to the same Organization as the shop; otherwise Shopify returns shop_not_permitted. Scopes come from the app's released version, so adding a scope means releasing a new version and approving it on the store.

sources.title: Shopify shopify-api OAuth guide, Client Credentials Grant
sources.quote: You should consider using the client credentials grant only when building apps for your own organization. ... The app can only use the client credentials grant if it belongs to the same Organization as the shop. Access tokens retrieved using the client credentials grant are valid for only 24 hours.

claims.claim: Protected customer data (PII) is a gating risk. Third-party connectors report that Shopify blocks or redacts customer names, addresses, emails and phone numbers on lower-tier plans, and returns them as null unless protected customer data access is configured on the app. PostHog quotes Shopify's error text naming the Shopify, Advanced and Plus plans. Databricks says Advanced and Plus. The sources disagree about which plans qualify.

sources.quote: "Access to personally identifiable information (PII) like customer names, addresses, emails, phone numbers is only available on Shopify, Advanced, and Plus plans"

sources.quote: the `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `phone`, and address-line fields are **silently redacted from the API response** unless the app has Protected Customer Data Access configured ... PCDA configuration UI is available on Shopify Advanced and Plus plans

claims.claim:
Minimum scopes for this agent, taken from Shopify's per-field requiredAccess data (2026-07):
- write_orders: orderCreate.
- read_orders: the Order object and the orders/* webhooks.
- read_products: Product and ProductVariant.
- read_inventory: InventoryLevel and inventoryLevels.
- read_locations or read_inventory: Location.
- read_customers: customerByIdentifier and the Customer object.
- write_customers: customerCreate, customerUpdate and customerWhatsAppMarketingConsentUpdate.
- write_draft_orders: only if using the draft path.
- read_fulfillments: fulfillments/create and fulfillments/update webhooks.

claims.claim: Rate limits are cost-based (a leaky bucket). Each response carries extensions.cost {requestedQueryCost, actualQueryCost, throttleStatus {maximumAvailable, currentlyAvailable, restoreRate}}, and a throttled request returns the error code THROTTLED. Shopify's client README shows example values of 1000 maximum and 50/s restore. A third-party skill gives 100 to 2,000 points per second depending on plan. I could not open the official limits page, so read throttleStatus at runtime rather than hard-coding numbers.

Customer lookup and creation by phone:
- Lookup: customerByIdentifier(identifier: {phoneNumber}) needs read_customers, or use customers(query: "phone:+57...").

claims.claim: Webhook verification: Shopify signs each delivery in the X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 header. The value is a base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the app's client secret. Other headers are X-Shopify-Topic, X-Shopify-Shop-Domain, X-Shopify-API-Version, X-Shopify-Webhook-Id (for deduplication) and X-Shopify-Event-Id. The newer 'events' deliveries use lowercase shopify-hmac-sha256 and shopify-webhook-id instead. Deliveries triggered manually from the store's Notifications settings fail this check.

Order webhook topics (WebhookSubscriptionTopic, 2026-07):
- ORDERS_CREATE: 'Occurs whenever an order is created'. It also fires for orders created through the API, which is what fulfillment apps listen to.
- ORDERS_UPDATED, ORDERS_PAID, ORDERS_CANCELLED, ORDERS_FULFILLED, ORDERS_PARTIALLY_FULFILLED and ORDERS_EDITED need read_orders.
- FULFILLMENTS_CREATE and FULFILLMENTS_UPDATE need read_fulfillments.
- INVENTORY_LEVELS_UPDATE and PRODUCTS_UPDATE are useful for keeping a cached catalog fresh.
Subscribe with webhookSubscriptionCreate(topic, webhookSubscription: {uri}); callbackUrl is deprecated. The webhook payload's API version comes from the app configuration.
