claims.claim: Under Ley 1581, sending any message to a number is 'Tratamiento' (uso), and it needs prior, express and informed authorization obtained by a means that can be checked later. Marketing and contact lists do not fall under any of the Art. 10 exceptions.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 (verbatim text mirrored from SUIN-Juriscol id=1684507)
sources.quote: Artículo 9°. Autorización del Titular. Sin perjuicio de las excepciones previstas en la ley, en el Tratamiento se requiere la autorización previa e informada del Titular, la cual deberá ser obtenida por cualquier medio que pueda ser objeto de consulta posterior.

sources.title: Ley 1581 de 2012 Art. 3 definitions
sources.quote: a) Autorización: Consentimiento previo, expreso e informado del Titular ... g) Tratamiento: Cualquier operación o conjunto de operaciones sobre datos personales, tales como la recolección, almacenamiento, uso, circulación o supresión.

claims.claim: Silence or no reply can never count as consent, and tacit consent is not valid in Colombia. The one-off 'notify and continue after 30 business days' mechanism in Decreto 1377 Art. 10 applied only to data collected before the decree (27 June 2013) and had to be implemented within a month of publication. An opt-out-style blast ('reply STOP if you don't want offers') therefore cannot create marketing consent.

sources.title: Decreto 1377 de 2013 (mirrored from SUIN-Juriscol id=1276081; compiled into Decreto 1074 de 2015)
sources.quote: Art. 7 ... (iii) mediante conductas inequívocas del titular que permitan concluir de forma razonable que otorgó la autorización. En ningún caso el silencio podrá asimilarse a una conducta inequívoca. ... Art. 10. Datos recolectados antes de la expedición del presente decreto ... Parágrafo. La implementación de los mecanismos alternos de comunicación previstos en esta norma deberá realizarse a más tardar dentro del mes siguiente de la publicación del presente decreto.

sources.title: Corte Constitucional Sentencia C-748/11 (annexed to Ley 1581 text)
sources.quote: no está permitido el consentimiento tácito del Titular del dato ... Por ello, el silencio del Titular nunca podría inferirse como autorización del uso de su información

claims.claim: A number collected to fulfil a COD order may not be reused for promotions without new, express authorization. The decree expects the controller to go back to the holder for a new authorization when the purpose changes. That supports one strictly non-promotional message asking the business's own customers for marketing consent over the channel they already use. I found no SIC concept that confirms or forbids this, so it rests on interpretation.

sources.title: Decreto 1377 de 2013 Art. 5
sources.quote: el Responsable del Tratamiento debe comunicar estos cambios al Titular antes de o a más tardar al momento de implementar las nuevas políticas. Además, deberá obtener del Titular una nueva autorización cuando el cambio se refiera a la finalidad del Tratamiento.

sources.title: Sentencia C-748/11, principio de finalidad
sources.quote: la referida información se destinará a realizar los fines exclusivos para los cuales fue entregada por el titular ... Cualquier utilización diversa, deberá ser autorizada en forma expresa por el Titular. ... Si, con el tiempo, el uso de los datos personales cambia a formas que la persona razonablemente no espera, debe obtenerse el consentimiento previo del titular.

claims.claim: A bought or scraped list has no lawful path, not even a single consent-request message. Obtaining the data without the holder's authorization is itself prohibited. A mobile number is not 'dato público' under the decree's definition, so the Art. 10(b) exception does not apply. Using the list at all is unauthorised Tratamiento, and SIC fines reach 2,000 SMMLV. The only exception would be a seller who can show authorizations naming DV Digital as a recipient.

sources.title: Ley 1581 Art. 4(c) and Art. 23
sources.quote: c) Principio de libertad: ... Los datos personales no podrán ser obtenidos o divulgados sin previa autorización, o en ausencia de mandato legal o judicial que releve el consentimiento; ... a) Multas de carácter personal e institucional hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes

sources.title: Decreto 1377 Art. 3(2) and Art. 4
sources.quote: Salvo en los casos expresamente previstos en la ley, no se podrán recolectar datos personales sin autorización del Titular ... No se podrán utilizar medios engañosos o fraudulentos para recolectar y realizar Tratamiento de datos personales.

claims.claim: Ley 1581 Art. 12 sets the minimum content of any consent request: (a) the processing and its purpose; (b) that answering is optional when the question concerns sensitive data or minors' data; (c) the holder's rights; (d) the controller's identity, physical or electronic address and phone. Proof of the disclosure must be kept, and a copy of the authorization must be kept and handed over on request (Art. 12 par., Art. 17(b); Decreto 1377 Art. 8). Decreto 1377 Art. 5 also requires stating every specific purpose, and Art. 15 requires telling the holder how to reach the full privacy policy.

sources.title: Ley 1581 Art. 12 and Art. 17(b)
sources.quote: a) El Tratamiento al cual serán sometidos sus datos personales y la finalidad del mismo; b) El carácter facultativo de la respuesta a las preguntas que le sean hechas, cuando estas versen sobre datos sensibles o sobre los datos de las niñas, niños y adolescentes; c) Los derechos que le asisten como Titular; d) La identificación, dirección física o electrónica y teléfono del Responsable del Tratamiento. Parágrafo. El Responsable del Tratamiento deberá conservar prueba del cumplimiento de lo previsto en el presente artículo

sources.title: Decreto 1377 Art. 5, 8, 15
sources.quote: informarle los datos personales que serán recolectados así como todas las finalidades específicas del Tratamiento para las cuales se obtiene el consentimiento. ... Los Responsables deberán conservar prueba de la autorización otorgada por los Titulares

claims.claim: The SIC expects two separate evidence trails: proof of the authorization, and proof of the Art. 12 disclosure that came before it. SIC guidance also calls for one separately selectable checkbox per purpose. A boolean 'accepted' flag is not enough. These SIC guides were read only as quotes inside a secondary GitHub research document, because sic.gov.co was blocked.

claims.claim: Ley 2300 de 2023 Art. 5 extends the law to advertising sent by 'mensajería por aplicaciones o web' (WhatsApp). Par. 2 requires explicit acceptance for database-building promotions and an easy opt-out. Par. 3 limits sends to the Art. 3 hours: Monday–Friday 7:00–19:00, Saturday 8:00–15:00, never Sundays or holidays. Art. 8 exempts information the consumer requested. The consent request stays outside the law only if it contains no promotion; otherwise every one of these rules applies. I could NOT retrieve the text of Art. 5 Parágrafo 1, and every official host was blocked.

Cuando se realice una transacción comercial de bienes o servicios ... no podrá obligarse al consumidor a aceptar recibir mensajes comerciales de ninguna índole, salvo aquellos asuntos estrictamente relacionados con el bien o servicio adquirido. Cuando se trate de promociones para alimentar bases de datos, el consumidor deberá saberlo y aceptarlo de manera explícita. El emisor del mensaje deberá habilitar y disponer de un mecanismo ágil, sencillo y eficiente para cancelar en cualquier momento la recepción de mensajes

claims.claim: Before sending commercial content, the sender must check the CRC's Registro de Números Excluidos (RNE). Registering in the RNE revokes any earlier prospecting authorization. CRC Res. 7356/2024 extended the RNE to messaging apps. Any consent-request message that could be read as commercial should therefore be filtered against the RNE and sent only within legal hours.

Así, se entenderán revocadas las autorizaciones para fines de prospección comercial que los titulares hayan otorgado... anteriores a la inscripción en el Registro de Números Excluidos.

claims.claim: WhatsApp's Business Messaging Policy (last updated Sep 23, 2026) allows contact only with numbers that have opted in to receive messages from the business. It covers both the WhatsApp Business App and the Platform. A consent-request template, broadcast or group add sent to a number without that opt-in breaks policy, whatever the message says and whatever Colombian law allows. The policy also requires honouring opt-outs made on or off WhatsApp.

sources.title: WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy (Open Terms Archive capture of whatsapp.com), last updated September 23, 2026
sources.quote: You may only contact people on WhatsApp if: (a) they have given you their mobile phone number or username; and (b) you have received opt-in permission from the recipient confirming that they wish to receive subsequent messages or calls from you.

claims.claim: Meta's opt-in rules (updated Jun 16, 2026) accept a general opt-in that is not specific to WhatsApp, as long as local law is met. The opt-in must clearly state that the person is opting in to receive communications from the business and must name the business. Accepted methods include SMS, website, IVR and paper. Meta recommends opt-in per message category. So a COD customer who agreed to order messages from DV Digital counts as opted in for order messages, not clearly for marketing.

claims.claim: The default Shopify checkout marketing labels are 'Email me with news and offers' and 'Text me with news and offers'. The SMS disclaimer mentions text messages and 'Reply STOP'. None of the defaults mentions WhatsApp, names the business in the label, or contains the Art. 12 elements (purpose, rights, controller contact). Checkout customers therefore hold at most SMS or email marketing consent. Storefront translations or customisations may differ, so the owner should check the store's actual text.

claims.claim: Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-07 adds `CustomerPhoneNumber.whatsAppMarketingConsent` (state, optInLevel, updatedAt, collectedFrom, sourceLocation) and the mutation `customerWhatsAppMarketingConsentUpdate`. Neither exists in 2026-04. The state defaults to NEVER_SUBSCRIBED. `Order.customerAcceptsMarketing` covers email only. Shopify keeps no record of the wording or notice version that was shown, so DV Digital must store the Art. 12 notice text and version itself.

claims.claim: A template asking for marketing consent would be categorised MARKETING, not UTILITY. Utility 'Opt-In Management' only covers confirming an opt-in already collected on another channel, or confirming an opt-out. Utility also has to be non-promotional and specific to the user's order or account. Since April 9, 2025, a template submitted as UTILITY that Meta judges to be marketing is approved as MARKETING. Repeated misuse leads to rate limits and the WABA's utility templates being switched to marketing.

claims.claim: Price: I could not confirm the ~USD 0.0125 Colombia marketing rate from Meta itself, because Meta publishes per-country rates only as CSV downloads. A current BSP rate card effective Oct 1, 2026 lists Colombia at USD 0.0144 for marketing and 0.0009 for utility. One re-consent pass to 50,000 delivered numbers would then cost about USD 720, not 625. Meta charges only for delivered template messages, so numbers not on WhatsApp cost nothing.

A BSP says service messages start being billed at the utility rate from Oct 1, 2026, with 1,000 free per number per month. Meta's own page mirrored here predates that change, so it needs checking.

design_implications: Import the 50k with provenance, never as bare phones. Each row gets a source (SHOPIFY_CHECKOUT, COD_FORM, WA_INBOUND, PURCHASED, SCRAPED, UNKNOWN), a collection date and an evidence pointer. Hard-block every outbound send for PURCHASED, SCRAPED or UNKNOWN, and schedule those rows for deletion (supresión) rather than re-consent.

Add an append-only ConsentEvent table: phoneE164, customerId, purpose (ORDER_UPDATES, MARKETING_PROMOS, GROUP_INVITES, AI_ORDERING), channel (WHATSAPP, SMS, EMAIL), action (GRANTED or REVOKED), source, noticeVersionId, capturedAt, and evidence (wamid, button payload, form submission id, IP/UA). The noticeVersionId points to an immutable NoticeText row holding the full text and a hash. Current consent is a derived view. This covers Ley 1581 Art. 12 par. and Art. 17(b), which Shopify's consent object cannot, because it stores no wording.

Mirror WhatsApp marketing consent to Shopify with customerWhatsAppMarketingConsentUpdate (Admin API 2026-07+). Set state SUBSCRIBED, optInLevel CONFIRMED_OPT_IN when the customer taps a button in WhatsApp, and updatedAt. Treat Shopify as a copy; the legal record stays in the DV Digital database.

Marketing send gate: purpose=MARKETING_PROMOS and channel=WHATSAPP must be GRANTED and not revoked; the RNE check must be clear and recent; the time must be inside Ley 2300 hours in America/Bogota (Mon–Fri 07:00–19:00, Sat 08:00–15:00, blocked on Sundays and Colombian holidays). Apply the same gate to group-invite templates.

Keep order-confirmation messages (the existing DV Confirma flow) strictly free of promotions so they stay transactional and utility (Ley 2300 Art. 8, Meta utility rules). Never add upsells or 'ofertas' to them.

Prefer consent capture that costs nothing and is policy-safe: an unticked 'Quiero recibir ofertas de DV Digital por WhatsApp' checkbox with an Art. 12 notice in Shopify checkout and the COD form; an in-thread ask when a customer writes in (open 24-hour window); click-to-WhatsApp ads (72-hour free window); wa.me or QR links. After an opt-in collected on those channels, send the utility 'opt-in confirmation' template.

If a re-consent template is used for provable customers only: category MARKETING; no offers or prices; name DV Digital; include Art. 12 (a) purposes, (c) rights, (d) NIT or name, address, email and phone, plus a link to the política de tratamiento; quick-reply buttons 'Sí, acepto' and 'No, gracias'; store the button tap as evidence. Budget about USD 0.0144 per delivered message (about USD 720 per 50k), and send only within legal hours after the RNE check.

Handle opt-outs across all channels ('BAJA', 'STOP', a button) as a REVOKED event for MARKETING_PROMOS. Order-related messages keep working, and the bot stays usable (Ley 2300 Art. 5 Par. 2 exempts matters 'estrictamente relacionados con el bien o servicio adquirido').
open_questions: For each segment: how many numbers, where they came from (Shopify checkout, which COD app, WhatsApp chats, bought from whom, scraped from where), collection date range, screenshots of the exact form or checkbox wording, whether DV Digital was named, whether a política de tratamiento existed then and which version, and what evidence exists (Shopify customer export with SMS/email consent timestamps, COD-app logs).
Which COD form app was or is used, and did it show a separate unticked marketing checkbox? Does it write marketing consent to Shopify? I could not access vendor docs.
In Shopify Settings > Checkout, is the SMS/email marketing checkbox shown, and was it ever pre-selected? Is the checkout translated or customised for Colombia? The defaults found are English.
The exact text of Ley 2300 de 2023 Art. 5 Parágrafo 1. All official hosts (secretariasenado, funcionpublica, SUIN, CRC and MinTIC normogramas) were blocked, and no mirror contained it.

Is there any SIC concept or sanction that directly addresses a one-time consent-request message to existing customers? None was found, so the answer for the customer segments rests on interpretation of Decreto 1377 Art. 5 and C-748/11.
Meta's official Colombia marketing rate from its USD rate-card CSV (0.0125 or 0.0144?), and whether service messages really become billable on Oct 1, 2026. Both are confirmed only by a BSP doc.

Who is the legal controller for Art. 12(d): a Colombian entity (NIT, physical address) or a foreign one? Does the política de tratamiento cover the international transmission to Meta, Anthropic and hosting providers?
Is DV Digital already registered with the CRC to consult the RNE, and what share of the list is in the RNE?
